headline: Passage Burns Hot as Shelf and Expanse Churn
war_summary: Since the morning edition Callahan's Passage has tightened to ten Warden holdings with six changes in two hours and sixty-four on the day about The Latch and the Crumbling posts, showing 12,195 Colonial and 14,434 Warden casualties on the day. Stlican Shelf stands at two Warden, six Colonial and one neutral with seven changes in two hours and fifty-seven on the day about Breaker Town and Fort Hoarfrost, with 3,418 Colonial and 3,325 Warden casualties. The Weathered Expanse shows three changes in two hours and thirty-nine on the day about Frostmarch, Crow's Nest and Wightwalk at one Warden, seven Colonial and one neutral, with 10,052 Colonial and 15,474 Warden casualties and the latest wire at 09:11. Fisherman's Row counts four changes in two hours and fifty-one on the day about Dankana Post and Eidolo at six Colonial and three neutral. Mooring County has rekindled with five changes in two hours about The Wind Hills at eleven Warden to one Colonial, while Nevish Line, Linn Mercy and Marban Hollow have gone quiet in the last six hours.
